Sarah (AE): quick update — Acme EU POC is ready to move to contract. They want to sign via PO for their Irish subsidiary and requested HSM-backed KMS attestation. Need legal + finance guidance on acceptable POA, e-sign, and VAT/PO handling.

Lisa (Legal): can you paste the customer's redline? who is the counterparty legal contact? any specifics about KMS scope?

Sarah (AE): counterparty=Acme EU Holdings Ltd (Ireland). Redline excerpt below.

```
Section 7.2 Data Processing: "Customer requires keys to be stored and managed within the EEA using HSM-backed KMS. Redwood shall provide a written attestation of HSM deployment and key custody procedures within 10 business days of request."
```

Devon (Security): HSM attestation is feasible for Private or Dedicated with BYOK/HSM partner. Hosted API does not include third-party HSM attestation. We should mark this as a deployment-dependent capability on the orderform and avoid promising attestation for hosted plans.

Omar (FinOps): FYI on finance: confirm billing entity (Acme EU Holdings Ltd) and whether they will provide a PO number. VAT applies for Irish entity unless they give VAT-exempt docs. Also confirm net terms (Net30?). PO is required to bind if they insist on PO-based procurement.

Lisa (Legal): to accept POA we need either notarized POA or an eIDAS advanced/signature proof. If they plan DocuSign, they must attach a certified POA PDF or documented eID proof. Proposed addendum: require (1) PO reference, (2) attached notarized or eIDAS POA, (3) explicit deployment line if HSM attestation requested. Also include fallback: "If POA not provided within 14 days of signature request, Redwood may void the orderform."

Devon (Security): add clause: "Security attestation timeframe is subject to product ops capacity and may require an SOW for HSM attestation." Avoids overcommit.

Omar (FinOps): that works. Once we have PO# and billing entity, finance will issue invoice. Ask customer for VAT reg number if VAT-exempt handling needed.

Sarah (AE): I'll request notarized POA or eIDAS proof, confirm PO number and whether they require HSM attestation or will accept BYOK on Dedicated. I'll also attach the full redline PDF when they send it.

esig-bot: Envelope created (env_0xD1E2F3) for Order Form + MSA addendum — awaiting signatures.

Lisa (Legal): thanks. please add counterparty counsel contact and target signature date. I'll prepare the addendum and mark the HSM attestation clause as "deployment-limited". Will also list acceptable POA formats in the addendum.

Sarah (AE): will do. pinging Acme procurement off-thread now. :pray:
